placements.purpose: A small fuel store differentiates the western home without changing its architecture.
Low ground flowers soften the yard edge; no new fence or obstruction.
Low blue flowers mark the eastern home; its tight doorway lane stays open.
One small side-garden accent; no tall tree or duplicate building.
Single front-side planter distinguishes the plaza-facing home.
A low second garden accent stays away from the home interaction stand.
Shared water point on the grass lot east of the plaza; leaves the plaza center empty.
One resting place beside the well, fully north of the protected east-west route.
Single plaza-edge lamp, clear of the guild sightline and western entry route.
A resident just below the western home yard looks toward the shared lane; does not stand in its door.
A resident at the plaza-facing garden edge makes the house feel occupied while keeping the door approach empty.
A resident faces the shared well from its east side, separate from the resting bench.
A single guard watches the northeast entry from an inside verge, away from the gate centerline.

notes: Full-canvas display sizes preserve all source margins and use uniform authored scale.
Collision rectangles bound authored projected base footprints, not whole silhouettes. Tree collision is trunk-only.
Low ground decorations including grass, flowers, ferns, reeds, roots, scree and river stones are nonblocking and below actors.
L-corner rectangle conservatively blocks its inside; replace with two wall-arm colliders for precision. Diagonal log capsules similarly use conservative AABBs.
